name: Deberc
description: Deberc, the klaberjass-family card game, against computer players in a panel, to play while Claude works: four in pairs or three each for themselves, first to 501. It pauses when a Claude tab of the window finishes and waits for you. Reads only the window's tab statuses; never types into a session.
author: Oleg Bronzov

fourColour.title: Four-colour deck
fourColour.description: Diamonds blue and clubs green, so each suit has its own colour as well as its own symbol.
